sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Mritunjay Mohan Sahai
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed for quashing of the order dated 26.07.2023 passed by District
Magistrate, Kushinagar.

2.  The decision has been taken on the claim of the petitioners for award of compensation to them at present market rate for the land said to have been purchased by Motilal father of petitioners No. 1 to 4 vide sale deed dated 17.06.1964 from one Bandhu S/o Abhilakh.

The finding recorded in the impugned order is that the sale-deed was obtained fraudulently after issuance of notification under Raj Kumar 8 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165480135/
1 Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on 28.12.1959 and under Section 6 on 18.06.1960.

entities.text: Raj Kumar 8 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is also recorded that possession of the acquired land was taken and delivered to the beneficiary i.e.
U.P. State Road Transport Corporation on 22.09.1961.
The vendor was not left with any right to transfer the property as it had vested in the Government in pursuance of land acquisition proceedings.
On the date, the sale-deed was obtained, the roadways bus stand was in operation.
In support of the said finding, the report of Commissioner submitted in a case in District Court has been relied upon.
It is also recorded that compensation for the acquired land was duly paid to the recorded tenure holders.
The claim of the petitioners for compensation made after twenty years is wholly frivolous and has, accordingly, been rejected.
3. Shri Vasistha Tiwari, counsel for the petitioners, after making brief submissions, does not press the writ petition in view of the above findings.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as not pressed.

Order Date :- 15.3.2024 Mukesh Kr.
(Kshitij Shailendra,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
